status: Read-only implementation-ready reproducer proposal; no test execution, source fix or gate mutation
candidate: Whether persisted agency suspension must revoke retained dashboard realtime admission and periodic authorization

original_finding.finding: Agency-suspension invalidation not explicitly checked; scope-policy follow-up, not certified vulnerability.

current_authority_and_consumer_trace.observation: Signed access token -> durable require_dashboard_session -> live UserModel/UserSecurityStateModel -> credential/session/role/agency match -> effective-user access-level callback -> tenant-qualified bounded group/assignment IDs. No AgencyModel join/activity predicate.
Validates exact session/user/version, unrevoked and unexpired session. Does not consult agency activity.
Each admission/refresh uses a fresh real AsyncSessionFactory session and passes signed access-level cookies through existing canonical helper; successful read commits, failures rollback.
Repeats real authorization after configured bounded interval. AuthenticationError ->4401, AuthorizationError ->4403, unexpected error ->1013; otherwise updates existing connection authorization.
Compares immutable authentication boundary, then replaces/reindexes current trip membership. It does not independently query DB or activity.
Offers hint only to existing exact (agency_id,trip_id) index. No independent live DB/agency query per hint.
Authorization task failure propagates close code; finally cancels/drains owned tasks and unregisters connection. Reproduction must exercise this cleanup if claiming delivery revocation.
Emits type,trip_id,cursor,invalidation; no names/documents/phone/account identifiers. This issue alone cannot establish private content access.

policy_evidence_and_limits.evidence: Explicit active AgencyModel predicate denies inactive assigned company workspace.
When require_agency is true, exact expected agency joins with is_active=True before WhatsApp roster changes.
Selecting a reduced superadmin access level explicitly requires active agency.
Generic shared authentication checks user.is_active only; does not establish a universal active-agency requirement.

Persisted is_active updates do not themselves rotate user/session state in this method. No maintained agency-suspend handler was located by named AgencyRepository/agency.is_active searches in this trace; no claim of complete external/admin operator closure.

sequence: Call actual authorize_dashboard_realtime and assert exact healthy agency/trip snapshot.
Commit AgencyModel.is_active=False in an independent session, leaving user/security/session/assignments unchanged.
Call actual authorize_dashboard_realtime through a new session and record whether it still returns same snapshot; assert durable row is inactive from a separate verification session.
controls: Revoked dashboard session rejects through existing AuthenticationError.
Deactivated user rejects through existing AuthenticationError.
Removing staff group access removes only corresponding trip; unrelated agency never enters snapshot.
proposed_tests.interpretation: Returning unchanged membership confirms current behavior only. Expected denial requires root adoption of intended realtime agency suspension policy; do not label a failing invented-policy assertion as a demonstrated vulnerability.

proposed_tests.phase: B - actual refresh and consumer boundary
sequence: Register actual bounded MobileRealtimeConnection in existing in-memory/fake-Redis hub test configuration using the healthy real authorization.
Run actual _refresh_dashboard_authorization with deterministic one-cycle scheduling and actual authorization wrapper, not a mocked authorization result.
If denial policy is adopted, exercise serve_registered_realtime_connection finally cleanup and assert expected close code/unregister, then actual hub.fanout of same-trip PII-free hint delivers zero.
controls: Healthy one-cycle refresh retains registration and delivers exactly one hint.
Scoped superadmin mode continues to use effective agency; unscoped superadmin still rejects as before.
Avoid hanging infinite loop: bounded wait_for and explicit event/cancellation teardown; never patch global asyncio.sleep into recursion.
proposed_tests.interpretation: No immediate revocation promise before configured refresh interval. No deployment-wide Redis/WebSocket concurrency or private durable-read policy conclusion.

minimal_fix_if_policy_and_baseline_adopt.approach: After effective_user establishes nonnull effective agency, query actual agency ID with is_active=True and raise existing AuthorizationError for absent/inactive agency before scoped trip snapshot. Prefer a direct bounded existence predicate over new global auth policy, registry/provider mutation or cached activity.

Existing4403 mapping, refresh interval, hub cleanup/capacity and PII-free payload.
